'''Rootwood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] that could be obtained on<ref name="Teebo" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Vulgarr/Legends|Vulgarr]], the leader of a band of the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]], once wielded a gnarled and lumpy rootwood [[Club/Legends|club]] during an attack on the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Teebo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rootwood appeared in ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', a [[1984]] young reader book written by [[Joe Johnston]].<ref name="Teebo" />
